implementationRevision: a1b3e66 (feature/goz-0008-child-identities), converged at pass 4 with 0 findings; security review items 1-9 pass. Tests and demo were not re-run by the analyst (T096 evidence in progress.yaml); make validate passed after the prompt edits.

findings.title: Child identity contract v1: gz://<origin>/cap/<capability-uuid>/<kind>/<child-uuid>, no aliases, exact kind+nativeName match in publication sequence, install-only duplicate-marked children never matched, present/absent only, FR-014 declared-not-verified notice and no badges, gap-free per-capability ordinal, random UUIDv7 (matching deterministic, IDs not reproducible), not in statement v1
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Children/ChildAssigner.cs (ChildKey ordinal compare, ExistingChildren.Matchable excludes duplicates, Guid.CreateVersion7)
findings.recommendation: Record the contract in every dependent prompt (and the publishing prompts 0009-0011); any change to form, key or duplicate rule is a contract change and a maintainer decision.

findings.title: Projection generations: generation 1 is the stored attested projection (no copy); later generations additive, immutable, unattested, only via owner-login projection-regenerate (exit 0/1/2/3/64), same (kind,nativeName) multiset, compared within adapter/projection version; child views use generation 1 titles (A8); generation and child IDs never interchangeable
findings.recommendation: Only generation 1 / statement v1 projection.digest may be called attested; specific notes in 0013, 0015, 0017, 0022, 0028, 0031, 0032.

findings.title: Publication delta: separate publish rule catalogue v1 (publish.duplicate_entry, publish.nul_character; 422 after validation, before version_exists; validate unchanged), extra 503 causes (rollout gap A7, child-table refusal F4), atomic revision+generation 1+children, deferred completeness triggers make any manifest_revisions insert without generation 1 and full child records uncommittable for every login
findings.recommendation: Every new publication path and every revision-creating test fixture goes through RevisionPublisher/ChildStore; new publish-time rules extend the versioned publish rule catalogue. Specific note in 0009.

findings.title: Pins after GOZ-0008: migration 20261122000000_ChildIdentities (3 tables, is_operator() read branch on manifest_revisions_select), 9 migrations, LATEST_MIGRATION /_ChildIdentities$/, StatusEndpointTests schemaVersion, BootstrapBoundary 6 matching tables, RlsCatalogTests 12 tenant-owned, 32 scoped endpoints (manifest.read 11, manifest.list 2, 22 actions/6 resources), Playwright goz-0008, ChildPageSize, install step in migrate, demo accumulates children and generations on manifest-demo
findings.recommendation: Supersede the GOZ-0007 counts and pins in every prompt.

findings.title: Telemetry and audit: spans gozleme.children.assign / gozleme.projection.generation.record / gozleme.children.install / gozleme.operator.projection_regenerate, counters gozleme.children.assignments and gozleme.projection.generations (after commit), audit 1601-1604 (range 1601-1610 held; next module 1701); no names, titles, native names or digests anywhere
findings.recommendation: Supersede 'the next module takes 1601'; record span, counter and audit names.

findings.title: Access: five org-private GET endpoints on manifest.list/manifest.read (no new action), GOZ-0007 read order, 405 on writes, no re-projection route; is_operator() read-all branches must never back a public/peer path; child presentIn/history/ordinal/latest/absent and revision children are computed over all revisions (count/facet leak if visibility is finer than capability)
findings.recommendation: Recorded in conventions; clarification questions routed to GOZ-0012 (visibility granularity) and GOZ-0034 (child-level grants).

findings.title: Child IDs are local, random and unattested: SC-003 makes matching deterministic but not UUIDs, statement v1 has no child member, so approvals, lockfiles, imports and cross-registry references cannot carry local child UUIDs as portable identity; the contract defers portability to GOZ-0012/0028/0030
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Children/ChildAssigner.cs (doc: 'only the child UUIDs differ'; Guid.CreateVersion7)
findings.recommendation: Route a clarification question (portable child key such as canonical capability ID + version + kind + nativeName, or source child UUID as recorded-not-attested) to 0021, 0024, 0028, 0030; do not decide here.

findings.title: Approval and materiality boundary: contract v1 forbids approval/trust/safety/lifecycle/verification badges on child views and gives a child only present/absent; projection entries carry only kind/nativeName/title, so schema/description changes show only as native.digest; per-child approval needs a versioned contract change and must bind child ID + revision + both digests; a later generation is not a material change

Search and embeddings over children: index from revision_children (generation 1 titles, A8); which generation is indexed is a clarification; later-generation text is unattested; projection generations are unrelated to embedding index generations
findings.recommendation: Specific alignment in 0013, 0015, 0017; clarification routed to 0013.

findings.title: Federation import, snapshot, feed and conflict: imported revisions cannot enter the local revision tables (completeness triggers, child guards); source duplicate keys or U+0000 are refused only for local publication; later generations are local additive records on immutable revisions (feed event question); child-UUID divergence between registries is not an authority conflict
findings.recommendation: Specific alignment and clarification questions in 0030, 0031, 0032, 0036.

findings.title: Recovery, upgrade and operator surface: child insert guards and deferred completeness triggers bind restores (restore with triggers disabled, as GOZ-0007-IF-07); migrate runs the install step every time; a pre-GOZ-0008 revision with U+0000 is skipped (1604 every run) and its capability answers 503 to publication permanently with no remedy command (accepted F3 consequence); rollout-gap 503; third owner-login command and is_operator() read-all branch (A2/A4) keep GOZ-0005-IF-04 open at GOZ-0039; optional log_error_verbosity=terse
evidence: docs/specs/008-child-identities/progress.yaml (converge pass 4 informational note; decisions A2, A4, nul-character)
findings.recommendation: Release procedure restores with triggers disabled and proves SC-002 and verification after restore; release notes report 1604; GOZ-0039 clarify decides GOZ-0005-IF-04. Restore impact inferred from the migration code, not reproduced.

findings.title: Relationship graph and overlays: edges and overlays reference children by canonical child ID and revision, never write child tables; absent children still resolve; cross-registry child references need a portable key (IF-07)

Question: the child summary member `latest` ('the latest revision (highest sequence) in which the child is present', API and ChildList 'child-latest') may read as a latest-revision designation, which GOZ-0007's maintainer ruling excludes (owned by GOZ-0026/0027)
findings.recommendation: Maintainer to choose: (a) accept as a per-child display and document it as 'last declared in' (no code change), or (b) rename the member before merge (API, web, tests; a GOZ-0008 code change through drive-speckit). Downstream guard note added to 0012, 0026, 0027 either way.

findings.title: The decision register does not record the GOZ-0008 maintainer rulings that change contracts or security posture: Q1 child ID form (namespace contract change), A2 is_operator() read-all branch on manifest_revisions_select and child tables, A4 third owner-login operator command (beyond the GOZ-0007-IF-14 acceptance of the second), publish rule catalogue v1 / validate-publish delta (Q2), F3 U+0000 skip with permanent 503, F4 child-refusal 503
findings.recommendation: Approve an additive set of rows in 'Maintainer rulings from spec delivery' (proposed text in the impact analysis). The analyst does not edit the decision register.
